title: Elf Bar Plus50 Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice blends three bold berries into one satisfyingly cool vape. Sweet Strawberry leads the mix with a soft, summery note, followed by tangy Raspberry and deep, juicy Cherry. A streak of icy Menthol lifts the whole blend, keeping it vibrant and fresh across every puff. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid and connects seamlessly to a 10ml refill tank, offering up to 5,500 puffs per pod. Designed for use with the Elf Bar Plus50 Kit, the built-in mesh coil ensures smooth vapour and consistent flavour—ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping.
